That Council agree to reduce the timeframe to amend the proposed 2027 budget from 30 days to nine (9) days as per subsection 7(4) of O. Reg 530/22; and
That Council request that the Mayor consider issuing a Mayoral decision to reduce the timeframe to veto a budget amendment to the proposed budget, if required, from ten (10) days to nine (9) days as per subsection 7(7) of O. Reg 530/22; and
